body:
This PR moves CI and the experiment environments to Julia 1.13 and CUDA 6. CUDA.jl 5 is slow on Julia 1.13. With CUDA 5.11.3 and GPUCompiler 1.17.1, the flagship AMIP GPU run has DRAM traffic of ~9 TB! per coupling step and slows from ~0.29 s to 8 s per step ([perf build](https://buildkite.com/clima/climaatmos-end-to-end-performance/builds/431), [profile](https://buildkite.com/clima/climaatmos-end-to-end-performance/builds/435)). CUDA 6 doesn't have this problem, so AMIP and CMIP now require it.

Changes
- Buildkite loads `climacommon/2026_10_30-1.13.3` on `central` and `climacommon/2026_11_06-1.13.3` on `clima`
- GitHub Actions tests 1.10 and 1.13, and docs build on 1.13
- `Manifest-v1.13.toml` replaces `Manifest-v1.11.toml` in `experiments/AMIP` and `experiments/CMIP`
- AMIP and CMIP require CUDA 6, and AMIP moves to CUDA 6.4.1 and GPUCompiler 2.10.0
- CMIP keeps its package versions apart from `HDF5_jll` and `NetCDF_jll`, which need newer builds on 1.13
- The `regrid_to_model_levels` test builds its dimensions with an `OrderedDict`, since Julia 1.13 changed `Dict` iteration order

On this branch the flagship AMIP GPU run takes ~0.32 s per coupling step (0.254 SYPD), the same as main on Julia 1.11 with CUDA 5 (0.32 s, 0.255 SYPD). See this branch's nightly [build](https://buildkite.com/clima/climacoupler-coarse-nightly-amip/builds/1608) and main's [build](https://buildkite.com/clima/climacoupler-coarse-nightly-amip/builds/1605). The other two failures in that build, the coarse AMIP 1M `DomainError` and the CMIP `linear_ind` error, also fail on main.

Once this merges, `COUPLER_COMMIT` in ClimaAtmos `.buildkite/coupler_perf/pipeline.yml` should point to the new commit.
title: Move to Julia 1.13 and CUDA 6
